name: maintenance
title: Maintenance mode
description: Switch the site to a proper 503 page from an env var or a scheduled window, with a bypass link for your team and an advance-notice banner.

env.name: MAINTENANCE_MODE
env.description: "on" shows the maintenance page to everyone (except bypass holders)

env.name: MAINTENANCE_BYPASS_TOKEN
env.description: Visit any URL with ?maintenance=<token> to browse normally during maintenance

env.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_MAINTENANCE_WINDOW
env.description: Scheduled window as start/end ISO times; announced 72h ahead, enforced while it lasts

maintenance.title: We'll be right back
maintenance.message: We're making some improvements. Thanks for your patience.

postInstall: Turn it on with MAINTENANCE_MODE=on (and redeploy or restart), or schedule it with NEXT_PUBLIC_MAINTENANCE_WINDOW.
Set MAINTENANCE_BYPASS_TOKEN and open /?maintenance=<token> to keep working on the live site.
